title: Whisker Chunks
description: A paid message from Whisker Chunks, the meatiest mystery chow this side of the Rio Grande.

lines.speaker: ad-ann-cat
lines.text: Weeell howdy there, partner! Out here on the lonesome prairie, every cat deserves a hearty supper at the end of a long cattle drive.

lines.speaker: ad-ann-cat
lines.text: Whisker Chunks is the meatiest mystery chow this side of the Rio Grande! Round up the herd, fill the trough, and watch them varmints chow down!

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: Whisker Chunks may contain cat. Not for cats. Or horses. Side effects include hairballs the size of tumbleweeds. Terms and conditions apply.
